provenance: Kingdom Come Phase 4.5 reconstruction; not recovered Storm8 formulas. Existing catalogs, balances and attained progression are preserved.

healing.policy: Full restoration costs missing Health times ceil(character level / 10). Natural recovery is settled first; full Health costs zero.

recruitment.legacyMembers: Retained unchanged; expand through consenting player allies or explicitly enabled development-rival invitations.

botEconomy.policy: Existing positive-net Land portfolios fund ordinary expenses. Once per saved shared hourly boundary, a bot may prepay maintenance using its own purse through the normal maintenance ledger. No wallet refill, Vault withdrawal, new property or equipment grant occurs.

income.policy: Retain the persistent character-wide 60-minute cycle. All holdings join it; purchases earn their actual eligible time, integer fractions carry forward, and selling settles only earned time once. Upcoming-purse projection subtracts maintenance due from unreserved gold and distinguishes prepaid reserve and retained treasury amounts.
